{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_only['revenue_float'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) in completed set
qa_in_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Output the full table for evidence
print(conversion_rates_sorted)

# Print the answer
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}')"}
